subject.title: [Feature]: Webhook hook sessions should reuse existing session when sessionKey is consistent (multi-turn support)

question: Should OpenClaw accept an explicit persistent hook-session mode for trusted webhook integrations, or keep hook-agent runs always isolated?
rationale: Persistent hook sessions change the security and compatibility boundary for externally triggered hook calls, so the implementation direction needs maintainer intent even though the code path is bounded.

options.title: Land explicit persistent mode
options.body: Adopt `sessionMode: "persistent"` for trusted direct and mapped hooks while preserving isolated as the default.

options.title: Keep hooks isolated
options.body: Reject persistent hook sessions and update docs/API wording so stable hook keys are not presented as multi-turn transcript identity.

recommendation.title: Land explicit persistent mode
recommendation.body: Adopt `sessionMode: "persistent"` for trusted direct and mapped hooks while preserving isolated as the default.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter already posted the maintainer cleanup comment confirming the remaining gap and preferred explicit `sessionMode` direction.
